common_tail: Keep every sign, text, building, vehicle design, robot design and person exactly as in the image; no new objects, no morphing, no camera shake, no cuts. Photorealistic, natural gentle motion, calm and quiet mood. Audio: natural ambient sound of the place only, no music, no speech, no singing.

P0.prompt: Locked-off static camera. Dusk on the beach. The man in the navy suit keeps walking slowly away toward the dunes; the wind grows stronger and lifts streams of fine sand off the dune crests, drifting across the beach and gradually thickening into a veil of blowing sand; the sea ripples; the abandoned island stays dark. Audio: wind, waves, hissing sand, one faint smartphone notification chime.

Audio: wind over the dunes, very distant soft booms of fireworks, insects.
